post.description:
Read every page of every file and save it as pending records.

A file or page that fails is reported in `files` / `failed_pages`, and the
others go on. When the daily quota runs out, the answer says whether sending
the file again is safe:
- nothing was saved: 503 quota_exhausted, and the file can be sent again;
- some pages were saved: 200 with quota_exhausted=true and those records.
  Sending the file again would save them twice.
Otherwise 200, unless the request itself is unusable (4xx).

parameters.name: X-Upload-Id

schema.description: Optional, made by the page (8-64 letters, digits or -). While the upload runs, GET /api/v1/extract/progress/{upload_id} counts its pages.

400.description: No files ("no_files"), more than MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST ("too_many_files"), or an upload that is cut off or broken ("invalid_upload")

401.description: Not signed in ("unauthenticated"). Nothing was read, so the file can be sent again

403.description: The request did not come from our own page ("origin_not_allowed")

413.description: Request over MAX_REQUEST_MB ("request_too_large") or over MAX_PAGES_PER_REQUEST ("too_many_pages")

503.description: The daily Gemini quota ran out before any page was saved ("quota_exhausted"): nothing was saved, so the file can be sent again. Also when the database is not reachable ("database_unavailable")

get.description:
How many pages of a running upload are read. 404 before it starts, after it
ends, and for an id the upload did not send.

In the `sort` order (newest first by default), then page number, then
commitment order.

`status=approved` is also the hand-off point for the lab's system (D6).

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Who saved it, by display name.

DuplicateOf.title: DuplicateOf
DuplicateOf.description: An earlier record with the same commitment number and the same central numbers.

done.title: Done
done.description: Pages read so far, failed ones included.

total.title: Total
total.description: Pages in the upload. 0 until the files are split into pages.

quota_exhausted.title: Quota Exhausted
quota_exhausted.description: The daily quota ran out after some pages were saved: stop sending files. The unread pages are in failed_pages with QUOTA_EXHAUSTED. When nothing was saved, extract answers 503 quota_exhausted instead.

FailedPage.title: FailedPage
FailedPage.description: A page whose extraction failed. It is not saved (A7) and is shown as failed (FR-12).

page_number.title: Page Number
page_number.description: The page it was read on: the form's first or a continuation page.

FieldBox.title: FieldBox
FieldBox.description:
Where the model read a value: a rectangle on one page of the form.

Edges are in thousandths of the page image as saved (upright, the same image
/api/v1/pages/{page_id}/image serves), 0 = top / left, 1000 = bottom / right.
Left is the image's own left: the page is never mirrored for RTL.

FieldEdit.title: FieldEdit
FieldEdit.description:
Leave a key out to keep it. value: null clears the field.

Sending a value unsets confirmed (SPEC 7.4).

FormField.title: FormField
FormField.description: One field, or one item of a list (central numbers, commitment numbers).

duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of
duplicate_of.description: DUPLICATE_RECORD only: every earlier record that is the same, oldest first.

idx.title: Idx
idx.description: Position of an existing item (keeps its raw). null adds a new item.

blocking_fields.title: Blocking Fields
blocking_fields.description: type "review_required" only: fields still flagged, e.g. "national_id", "central_numbers[1]".

continuation_pages.title: Continuation Pages
continuation_pages.description: Later pages of the same file that belong to this form. page_id / page_number are its first page.

continuation_page_ids.title: Continuation Page Ids
continuation_page_ids.description: The page_id of each continuation page, in the order of continuation_pages. Load its image from /api/v1/pages/{page_id}/image.

version.title: Version

approved_by.title: Approved By

updated_by.title: Updated By
updated_by.description: Display name of who last edited it; null if never edited.

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: Pending records with a field still flagged.

RecordCounts.title: RecordCounts
RecordCounts.description:
The counters on the records screen.

Counted over the other filters (q, sender, form_type, dates) but not status or
needs_review, so they stay put while the user switches between them.

field.title: Field

display_name.title: Display Name

RecordEvent.title: RecordEvent

Never the values (D13).

total.title: Total

central_numbers.title: Central Numbers

siblings.title: Siblings
siblings.description: Other records of the same form whose shared fields changed too (A3).

RecordSummary.description: A row on the records screen: effective values only, straight from the record table.

blocking_fields.title: Blocking Fields
